title: Magpie
blurb: True magpies are birds of various species of the family Corvidae. Like other members of their family, they are widely considered to be intelligent creatures.
facts: The Eurasian magpie, for instance, is thought to rank among the world's most intelligent creatures, and is one of the few nonmammalian species able to recognize itself in a mirror...
Magpies have shown the ability to make and use tools, imitate human speech, grieve, play games, and work in teams.
They are particularly well known for their songs and were once popular as cagebirds.
